title: Sorting dropdown
description:
If the user clicks on the "Sort" button, a dropdown menu opens with which he can influence the sorting of the products on the list.

Uses [**dropdown menu**](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=606-17197&t=reqgsA9rbH2D4nWh-4) **with indicator** 

* the indicator marks the active sorting option
* only one option can be selected

Please look at component props in figma.

## Techincal details

by <custom data-type="mention" data-id="id-0">@bassem mohamed</custom> and <custom data-type="mention" data-id="id-1">@Sebastian Langer</custom> 

Create a re-usable SelectDropdown component which acts like a <select> element but uses the dropdown component. E.g.

```
<script setup lang="ts">
const items = ref([
  {
    label: 'Backlog',
    value: 'backlog'
  },
  {
    label: 'Todo',
    value: 'todo'
  },
  {
    label: 'In Progress',
    value: 'in_progress'
  },
  {
    label: 'Done',
    value: 'done'
  }
])
const value = ref('backlog')
</script>

<template>
  <LuiSelectDropdown v-model="value" :items="items" />
</template>
```

Create a story displaying the component.

See similar component from nuxt ui:

summary: Reusable select dropdown component for product sorting with custom dropdown UI and active selection indicator.
features: Single selection with visual active indicator
Dropdown menu with customizable option list
Keyboard navigation with arrow keys and Enter
longDescription:
## Purpose

The Sorting Dropdown component enables users to organize product results on the listing page by selecting from available sorting options such as price, popularity, newest arrivals, or relevance. It provides a familiar select-like interaction pattern with enhanced visual styling.

## Use Cases

- Open sorting dropdown via the "Sort" button on the filter bar
- Display available sorting options with clear labels
- Indicate the currently active sorting option with a visual marker
- Allow single selection that immediately updates the product order
- Support keyboard-driven selection for accessibility

## Design Rationale

The component wraps standard dropdown menu functionality in a select-like API, making it easy to integrate with form state management via v-model. The active indicator provides clear feedback about the current sort state. The design follows the established dropdown menu patterns while being purpose-built for the sorting use case on product listing pages.
shortDescription: Acts like a native select element but uses the custom dropdown component for enhanced styling. Opens via the Sort button on filter bar. Only one option can be selected at a time with immediate product order update. Similar to Nuxt UI select component pattern. Uses LuiDropdownMenu internally.
